FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THE
MINIPE PRADESHIYA SABHAUNDER SECTION 65A(2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS the office of a member in Minipe Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of being ceased to be a memberof the party ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely United National Party, to which the formermember Bandaranayake Mudiyanselage Shantha Sisira Kumara Bandaranayake belonged, was required by me under Section65A(2) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to nominate within a period of thirty (30) days a person eligible under the ordinance forelection as a member of that Minipe Pradeshiya Sabha who shall be declared elected as a member ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. SamarakoonMudiyanselage Manoj Sanjeewa Samarakoon being an eligible person under the aforesaid Ordinance to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Talangama Appuhamilage Chaminda Namal Talangama, Returning Officer of Minipe PradeshiyaSabha, acting in terms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by Filling of Vacancies inLocal Authorities (Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. Samarakoon MudiyanselageManoj Sanjeewa Samarakoon elected as a member of the Minipe Pradeshiya Sabha.
Returning Officer,Minipe Pradeshiya Sabha.District Elections Office,Kandy,24th April, 2015.
